Checkpoint.description: Unit-level checkpoint (V1-B2). Enables kill-and-restart without duplication.
Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

DefensibilityClass.description:
Spec §5.6: `fact | utterance | non_factual`.

*fact*        — the unit asserts something the matrix permits as fact.
*utterance*   — someone said it; the system stands by the saying, not
                the substance.
*non_factual* — opinion / interpretation / rhetorical content.
DefensibilityClass.title: DefensibilityClass

DefensibilityRing.description:
Spec §5.6: class + score_vector + matrix_rule_ref.

`matrix_rule_ref` ties this unit back to a specific row of the
governed Qualification Matrix. Solva will refuse to stamp a
`defensibility_class` higher than the matrix row's ceiling.

`runtime_mode` flags whether this stamp was produced by the
declaration baseline (per-feed MEA declaration) or the inference
overlay (V3-gated content classifier). Until V3 passes, all
stamps run with `runtime_mode == "declaration_baseline"`.

matrix_rule_ref.description: Foreign key into the Qualification Matrix (matrix_rule_id@rev).
matrix_rule_ref.title: Matrix Rule Ref

runtime_mode.description: Spec: declaration baseline by default; inference overlay once V3 passes.
runtime_mode.title: Runtime Mode

DefensibilityRing.title: DefensibilityRing

Modality.description:
What kind of raw bytes were the source for this unit.

Spec §4.3: "parallel per-modality perception pipelines". This enum is
the modality-aware seam between Layer A (Retrieve) and Layer B
(Perceive). New modalities require an explicit enum extension AND a
snapshot bless.
Modality.title: Modality

NormalizedUnit.description:
The single modality-neutral unit produced by Layer C.

Every Layer-D primitive reads from `NormalizedUnit`s. Services 1 and 2
never see the raw bytes — only this. Spec §4.4 + §5.1.

unit_id.description: Stable UUID for this unit; cross-referenced by Relational edges.
unit_id.title: Unit Id

NormalizedUnit.title: NormalizedUnit

ProvenanceRing.description:
Spec §5.2: deterministic, always present.

Fields:
  * source_ref          — file/feed pointer the raw bytes came from
  * modality            — which modality this unit was perceived from
  * locator             — modality-native locator (page+span for text,
                          t_start_ms/t_end_ms for audio/video, bbox
                          for image). Carried as a free dict so each
                          modality can declare its own shape; the
                          schema does not constrain content here.
  * speaker_or_author   — attributed person/org if known; None if
                          perception couldn't attribute.
  * context             — free text describing the surrounding
                          context (programme title, file purpose,
                          segment label …).

context.description: Free-text surrounding context: programme, segment label, file purpose.
context.title: Context

locator.description: Modality-native locator. Examples: text → {page:int, span:[int,int]}; audio/video → {t_start_ms:int, t_end_ms:int}; image → {bbox:[x,y,w,h]}.
locator.title: Locator

modality.description: Which modality this unit was perceived from.

source_ref.description: Stable pointer to the source file or feed slice.
source_ref.title: Source Ref

speaker_or_author.description: Attributed person or organisation. Null if not attributable.
speaker_or_author.title: Speaker Or Author

ProvenanceRing.title: ProvenanceRing

purged_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the purge attestation.

ReextractionHandleRing.description:
Spec §5.5: deterministic re-extraction handle.

Carries enough information to re-run perception against the same raw
bytes with the same model + params, byte-for-byte reproducible.

extraction_params.description: All inputs that materially affect output (sample-rate, chunk-size, prompt, thresholds, …).
extraction_params.title: Extraction Params

model_id.description: Identifier of the perception model used.
model_id.title: Model Id

model_version.description: Version of the perception model used.

raw_pointer.description: Stable storage key for the raw bytes (S3 / local).
raw_pointer.title: Raw Pointer

RelationType.description: Spec §5.4: edge taxonomy. Closed at G0; extension requires bless.
RelationType.title: RelationType

RelationalEdge.description: One edge in the Relational ring graph. Spec §5.4.

evidence_ref.description: Optional pointer to the evidence that grounds this edge.
evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref

RelationalEdge.title: RelationalEdge

RelationalRing.description:
Spec §5.4: edges between units.

A unit may have zero edges (e.g. an isolated utterance). Empty
Relational ring is valid and expected at V1 timing.
RelationalRing.title: RelationalRing

ScoreVector.description:
Spec §5.6: five-dimensional defensibility score.

Each dimension is `float` in [0, 1]. The Solva depth governor (G1)
writes these; at G0 they are populated by the synthetic fixture or
left at 0.0 default.
ScoreVector.title: ScoreVector

SignalRing.description:
Spec §5.3: Solva-judged depth; modality-native dimensions.

G0 declares the *shape*; the catalogue of valid dimension keys per
modality is extensible. The Qualification Matrix and the Solva depth
governor will, at G1, restrict which dimension keys are recognised
per modality. At G0, dimensions are a free dict.

Examples:
  * audio   → {affect: float, prosody: float, vocal_emphasis: float}
  * text    → {hedge_density: float, attribution_density: float}
  * image   → {salience: float, occlusion: float}

`depth_judged` is the Solva stamp — only Solva (G1) writes this field.
TODO[G1]: enforce a catalogue per modality. Currently free.

depth_judged.description: True iff Solva has judged this unit's signal depth.
depth_judged.title: Depth Judged

depth_notes.description: Optional Solva note on depth judgement.
depth_notes.title: Depth Notes

dimensions.description: Modality-native signal dimensions, key → numeric value.
dimensions.title: Dimensions
